answer: Bindings are kept in lantern, verified in zenith, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 5 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the haven check. A farm generating text without memory of its own history thus fails the binding, thus it has to store and read state per alias. A farm of 2194 identities would post 3418 proofs and burn roughly 3 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
